data.name: Meemuna
data.gender_notes: Meemuna is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Meemuna is derived from the Arabic root word 'Ameen', which means 'faithful' or 'trustworthy'. In the Quran, Meemuna is mentioned as one of the names of Maryam (Mary), the mother of Isa (Jesus). This name signifies the tranquility and serenity that comes from having unwavering faith and trust in Allah. The name Meemuna carries the meaning “Tranquility, serenity” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Meemuna usually hope their child will grow to embody tranquility, serenity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of unwavering faith and trust in Allah
data.etymology: Meemuna belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Tranquility, serenity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Meemuna total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
